headline: Ukraine launches major drone strikes into Russia
standfirst: A massive overnight drone assault has reached the outskirts of Moscow.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Ukraine launched a major drone attack on Russia. It caused a warehouse fire near Moscow and killed six.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: This is one of the largest drone campaigns Kyiv has conducted since the war began.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The scale of this attack shows the conflict is increasingly reaching deep inside Russian territory.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch for how Moscow responds militarily to these strikes near its capital.

caption:
Ukraine has launched a significant drone attack on Russia resulting in a warehouse fire and multiple deaths.

Russian officials report that at least six people were killed during the overnight assault. This marks one of the most extensive drone operations Kyiv has mounted since the start of the full-scale invasion.
